task: adaptive-adversarial noisy deep black-box ReLU 2D folded region-graph decompilation

blackBox.type: adaptive generated 2-input / 4-hidden / 4-hidden / 1-output two-layer ReLU MLP teachers with stochastic output noise and quantization
blackBox.visibilityToGcl: oracle calls only: repeated noisy f(x,y), no hidden activations, layer widths, teacher weights, or profile labels are passed to the solver

adaptiveSearch.probing: two-pass adaptive probing: every generated candidate gets a cheaper screening pass; screening failures and selected hard cases get a refined noisy median probe pass; both stage and total query budgets are recorded
adaptiveSearch.selection: score each generated adversarial teacher by recovered deep region complexity, baseline gap, and residual hardness; fail the whole benchmark if any final generated candidate fails recovery gates

claimScope.proves: adaptive search-generated noisy deep folded 2D ReLU region-graph recovery across a deterministic adversarial candidate pool
claimScope.doesNotClaim: unique original hidden-layer weight recovery, exact layer attribution, arbitrary deep ND network extraction, or production API extraction beyond this benchmark noise model
